title: Arduino Uno
prompt: an Arduino Uno board on a desk: plug in USB, upload a sketch, the onboard LED blinks, wire an LED to pin 13; see-through labels the ATmega328P, USB chip, voltage regulator, crystal, reset button and header pins
blurb: Plug an Arduino Uno into USB, upload Blink through its bootloader and watch pin 13 flash the onboard L LED and a red LED wired on the breadboard.
